original_request: Add a new Step 2.5 PROCESSING between Step 2 (Downbeat/Beat Grid) and Step 3 (Slice) in WavePreviewPage with Gate, Expansion, Compression, Limiting, and EQ effects

enhanced_specification.title: Step 2.5 PROCESSING - Pre-Slice Audio Effects Chain
enhanced_specification.summary: Insert a new workflow step between Tempo (Step 2) and Slice (Step 3) that allows users to apply dynamics and EQ processing to the selected audio region BEFORE slicing. This makes the resulting sample slices cleaner by removing noise, controlling dynamics, and shaping tone.
deliverables: New WorkflowStep enum value: Step25_Processing (between Step2_DownbeatLoops and Step3_SampleSlice)
New step pill button: '2.5 PROCESSING' in the step navigation tabs
Processing control panel with 5 effect sections
Backend processing service to apply effects to audio buffer
Real-time preview of processed audio (affects playback)
Processed audio buffer passed to Step 3 for slicing

gate.description: Noise Gate - Silences audio below threshold to remove background noise

expander.description: Dynamic Expander - Reduces gain below threshold, opposite of compressor
expander.existing_code: NONE - Must be created new (JUCE lacks native expander, must implement)

compressor.description: Dynamic Compressor - Reduces dynamic range by attenuating loud signals

limiter.description: Brick-Wall Limiter - Hard ceiling to prevent clipping

enum_modification.change: Add Step25_Processing between Step2_DownbeatLoops and Step3_SampleSlice

transitions.from_step2: transitionToStep25() - Lock tempo grid, show processing controls
transitions.from_step25: transitionToStep3() - Apply processing to audio buffer, pass to slice step

audio_flow.step25_new: User configures effects -> effects applied to audio buffer -> processedAudioBuffer_
audio_flow.step3: Slice uses processedAudioBuffer_ instead of original

files_to_modify: src/ui/Pages/WavePreviewPage.h - Add Step25_Processing enum, new member variables, method declarations
src/ui/Pages/WavePreviewPage.cpp - Implement new step UI, transitions, processing logic
files_to_create: src/services/PreSliceProcessingService.h - Optional: dedicated service for processing

assumptions: Processing is applied to the entire selected region (not per-slice)
Processing is destructive to the workflow buffer (but original file untouched)
User can preview processed audio in real-time during playback
Processing order is fixed: Gate -> Expander -> Compressor -> Limiter -> EQ
Each effect can be individually bypassed via toggle
Step 2.5 is optional - user can skip directly to Step 3 if no processing needed

ui_requirements.control_layout: Horizontal strip of 5 effect modules in control panel area
per_effect_ui: 2-4 sliders per effect for main parameters
Compact display (must fit in existing control panel height)
ui_requirements.visual_feedback: Gain reduction meters for compressor/limiter (optional, nice-to-have)

thread_safety: Audio processing must NOT happen on UI thread
Use background thread for processing when user clicks 'Apply'
Or: process in real-time during preview playback (preferred)
